measurement.palette_and_species_scores: identical to validated Florence pilot v2/calibration extractor

primary_colour_representation.reason: preserves continuous/multimodal colour structure and is backward-compatible with discrete 0/1 mismatch statistics
primary_colour_representation.feature_scaling: species-specific mean and standard deviation frozen from reviewer-1 usable+fresh calibration rows before evaluation values are inspected
primary_colour_representation.discrete_morph_states: secondary/sensitivity only; not required for primary continuous spatial null

spatial_null.global_stage_a_species_weighting: equal species weight after within-species graph normalization
spatial_null.continuous_binary_compatibility: for a scalar 0/1 colour state, RMS edge distance equals the original mismatch indicator exactly

opening_scope: evaluation image pixels may now be downloaded and converted to frozen Florence numeric features; no reviewer2 decision is required for this stage
post_opening_rule: do not alter feature axes, scaling, ROI selector, palette/scoring, or within-species permutation rule in response to evaluation colour outcomes without versioning the analysis as a new development cycle
